Thursday 08 October 2026 · 22 stories
Morning Brief
Nifty 50 fell 0.76% to 22,603 and decliners led 1,459 to 1,074
Today’s read
The biggest names carried the session. The fifty most traded stocks returned +3.79% weighted by turnover, against -0.37% for the median stock, a gap of 4.2 percentage points, so most stocks did worse than the busiest names suggest.

One Mobikwik Systems Limited rose 5.8% on 94 times its usual volume, and it was in the news with “Paytm, Mobikwik, Pine Labs shares crash up to 10%. What’s behind the sharp plunge?”.

The exchange has formally asked 1 company to explain today's move: D P Wires Limited. Those queries were filed after the close, so they confirm the move rather than explain it. NSE's own surveillance flagged the same names.

Nothing in the news or in exchange filings explains the volume in D P Wires Limited (102x), Orient Technologies Limited (97x), Pradeep Metals Limited (89x). That usually points to a sector story rather than a company one.

27 stocks sit at 52-week lows against 8 at highs. New lows outnumbering new highs this clearly is usually a late signal, not an early one.

What happened
Breaking
Indian firms seen posting faster profit growth despite global headwinds
Consensus estimates project Nifty 50 earnings growth to accelerate to 11% year-on-year for the September quarter, up from 4% in the previous quarter. This acceleration supports elevated market valuations, where the Nifty 50 trades at 23 times trailing earnings, and helps absorb recent foreign portfolio outflows. Upcoming Q2 results from heavyweights like Reliance and TCS will confirm if domestic margins are holding up against rising input costs.
Reuters Business · +2 others
Ola Electric shares fall 10% as firm fixes price for ₹1,000-cr rights issue
Ola Electric approved a Rs 1,000-crore rights issue opening on October 22 to fund its capital expenditure. This equity dilution pressure tests investor appetite as rising competition from TVS Motor and Bajaj Auto squeezes EV market shares. Subscription data from the first three days of the issue will signal institutional confidence in Ola's long-term margin trajectory.
BS Markets · +2 others
Connected to your data
Paytm, Mobikwik, Pine Labs shares crash up to 10%. What’s behind the sharp plunge?
Fintech shares fell up to 10% on reports that the government will delay implementing a Merchant Discount Rate on UPI transactions. This delay pushes back the monetization timeline for high-volume payment transactions, directly impacting the path to profitability for One 97 Communications. Any official clarification from the National Payments Corporation of India would confirm the near-term fee structure.
ET Markets
Your themes
OBSC Perfection in focus after securing ₹8.9 Crore defence order from Elbit Systems unit - Trade Brains
OBSC Perfection secured an Rs 8.9-crore defense export order from a subsidiary of Israel's Elbit Systems. This contract highlights the integration of Indian precision engineering firms into global defense supply chains, supporting high valuation multiples across the small-cap defense sector. Quarterly execution timelines will determine when this order translates into revenue and cash flows.
DefenceDefence indigenisation
CoreWeave Enters India, Partners AdaniConneX For 240 MW Data Centre Capacity - Inc42
Adani Enterprises joint venture AdaniConneX signed an agreement with Nvidia-backed cloud provider CoreWeave to deliver up to 240 megawatts of data centre capacity across India. The contract secures multi-year lease visibility and de-risks capital expenditure for the platform. It signals that global artificial intelligence compute workloads are establishing base infrastructure in India, raising power demand visibility for industrial utilities.
AI & data centresData centres and AI capex
Does Google Nuclear Deal Change The Bull Case For NuScale Stock (SMR)? - Simply Wall Street
Google agreed to purchase nuclear power from Kairos Power to feed artificial intelligence data centres, spurring debate over small modular reactor developers. The development has no near-term transmission to Indian equities because private nuclear operation remains prohibited under current atomic energy regulations. Domestic engineering firms such as Larsen & Toubro remain tied exclusively to state-run reactor procurement by the Nuclear Power Corporation of India.
NuclearNuclear and SMR
Heterojunction solar cell built with biomass lignin-based silver paste achieves 25.96% efficiency - pv magazine India
Researchers developed a heterojunction solar cell using biomass lignin to replace part of the silver paste, reaching 25.96 percent efficiency. Silver paste represents up to ten percent of cell manufacturing costs, acting as a key hurdle for domestic manufacturers like Premier Energies and Reliance evaluating heterojunction technology. Commercial equipment integration and durability testing will decide whether this material substitution ever reaches volume factory lines.
Green energy & solarSolar and green energy
Capital markets
Gradiant names India MD, wins five water-treatment contracts across chip, PCB, solar sectors - Electronics For You BUSINESS
Industrial water treatment firm Gradiant secured five process water contracts across semiconductor, printed circuit board, and solar manufacturing facilities in India. The orders highlight rising industrial expenditure on zero liquid discharge and ultrapure water systems driven by electronics production-linked incentive schemes. This trend expands the high-margin industrial order pipeline for domestic water treatment specialists, including VA Tech Wabag and Thermax.
Water infrastructure
Oil jumps as Middle East supply concerns persist amid shipping attacks
Brent crude advanced past recent ranges following maritime transit disruptions in the Red Sea and heightened regional supply risk. Higher landed crude costs pressure gross refining and marketing margins at state oil marketing companies, while raising raw material costs for paint and chemical manufacturers. Each sustained five-dollar increase in crude prices widens India's current account deficit and increases imported inflation pressures for the Reserve Bank.
Reuters Business · +1 other
Dollar holds near 18-month high, euro lags as bond yields rise
The dollar index traded near multi-month highs as rising benchmark United States Treasury yields prompted traders to scale back expectations for rapid interest rate cuts. A firmer greenback accelerates foreign portfolio outflows from Indian equities and maintains downward pressure on the rupee. Conversely, currency depreciation improves realized rupee revenue and operating margins for export-oriented IT service providers and pharmaceutical companies.
Reuters Business · +1 other
Mapping the Market: Microsoft set to extend rally
Microsoft's projected revenue growth from its Azure cloud business signals sustained capital expenditure on artificial intelligence. This global tech spend directly drives the order pipeline for Indian IT services exporters like Infosys and TCS, who handle downstream integration. Watch for Microsoft's upcoming quarterly segment disclosures to confirm if enterprise AI spending is translating into actual software implementation contracts.
Reuters Business
Macro and economy
TCS Q2 results: Profit rises 15% YoY to Rs 13,884 crore; co declares dividend at Rs 12 per share
Tata Consultancy Services grew its second-quarter consolidated net profit by 15% year-on-year to Rs 13,884 crore, beating consensus estimates. This performance suggests stabilizing operating margins for the IT sector despite recent wage hikes, supporting valuation multiples across tier-one peers like Infosys and HCLTech. Management's commentary on North American banking client budgets will confirm if this demand recovery is sustainable.
ET Markets
Hotel stocks to check-in | Why buy Leela, Lemon Tree, ITC Hotels ahead of Diwali, holiday season? JM Financial explains
JM Financial projects hotel-sector revenue per available room to grow 12% to 13% year-on-year in the second quarter, led by a 15% expansion at Hotel Leelaventure. Strong leisure and corporate demand drive operating leverage for listed hoteliers like Lemon Tree and Indian Hotels, expanding their operating margins. Monthly occupancy data in November will confirm if this pricing power persists past the festive season.
Mint Markets
Global Market: Eurozone bond yields surge as energy prices fuel rate hike bets
Rising Eurozone bond yields, driven by elevated crude oil prices, increase global capital costs and pressure emerging market assets. For India, this transmission works through a weaker rupee and potential foreign portfolio capital outflows as the yield spread narrows. Weekly foreign portfolio investment data from NSDL will show if global funds are accelerating their sales of Indian equities.
ET Markets
Inside 11-quarter high earnings pomp, 46 companies may wipe out up to 84% of their Q2 profits
While aggregate corporate earnings look strong, forty-six major companies face second-quarter profit declines of up to 84% due to weak volume growth and high input costs. This divergence threatens valuations in the auto, cement, and consumer goods sectors, where input costs squeeze operating margins. Upcoming quarterly margin disclosures from Maruti Suzuki and UltraTech Cement will confirm the severity of this margin compression.
ET Markets

CoreWeave brings 240 MW AI cloud capacity to India with AdaniConneX - CRN Asia
US-based CoreWeave partnered with AdaniConneX to establish 240 megawatts of artificial intelligence cloud capacity in India. This joint venture directly boosts the infrastructure revenues of Adani Enterprises and increases domestic demand for industrial power and electrical equipment. Progress updates on the physical construction of these data centers over the next two quarters will confirm the execution timeline for this capacity.

Geopolitics
RBI intervention halts rupee's slide to record low, risks linger
The Reserve Bank of India intervened in the foreign exchange market to prevent the rupee from hitting a record low against the US dollar. This action stabilizes import costs for domestic manufacturers but limits the short-term margin expansion that export-oriented sectors like IT and pharmaceuticals gain from a weaker currency. Weekly foreign exchange reserve data will show the cost of this defense.
ET Markets
India’s Venezuelan oil imports set to hit highest level in nearly seven years
India's imports of Venezuelan crude are set to reach a seven-year high as refiners substitute increasingly expensive Russian barrels. This cheaper feedstock improves gross refining margins for complex refiners like Reliance Industries and public sector units including Indian Oil Corporation. Monthly import data from the Ministry of Commerce will confirm the sustainability of this sourcing shift.
Hindu BusinessLine · +1 other
UK’s Chinese EV tariff plan is a double-edged sword for Tata Motors PV
The UK's proposed tariffs on Chinese electric vehicles will protect Tata Motors' Jaguar Land Rover unit from low-cost competition in its home market. However, potential retaliatory tariffs by Beijing could hurt JLR's sales and margins in China, which remains a key profit driver. Next quarter's JLR regional sales mix will reveal the net impact of these trade barriers.
